title: P24 — Implement shutdown, monitoring and retention
description:
## Dispatch packet P24
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D11 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
Babulus
Primary paths: infra/rendering; operator CLI; watchdog. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. D11 soft pause/emergency stop, account budget/alerts, job cost reports. Retain customer source/output until explicit deletion; expire nonauthoritative temporary artifacts after 7 days and cap log retention at 14 days. Do not auto-delete valid customer exports.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
shutdown tests include queued/starting/running jobs and stale attempts; local processing unaffected.

## Dependencies
videoml-54b377 (P23)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.
